description: AEP conformance corpus. Each fixture carries the expected verdict per verification layer. Layers: structural (canonical JSON Schema), semantic (derived invariants — floor recomputation, cross-field consistency), authenticity (signature / DSSE binding). expected_python is 'not-implemented': no official wasmagent-py verifier exists (planned); the entry is reserved, not a claim.

fixtures.note: Canonical keeps signature optional — an unsigned record is protocol-valid. verifyAEPRecord returns false; verifyAEPRecordDetailed reports authenticity=unsigned.

A literal __proto__ key is an ordinary field for canonical canonicalization (JS defineProperty / Rust BTreeMap both preserve it). Consumers MAY reject it as local admission policy — that is a consumer decision, not a schema violation.

floor=principal_key_signed over observed [operator_asserted, principal_key_signed] violates weakest-grade-wins. Producers MUST reject at emission; verifiers SHOULD detect at conformance time (see #214).
